Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 106. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

You are an expert at slinking through shadows. You
gain the following benefits:
You can try to hide when you are lightly obscured
from the creature from which you are hiding.
When you are hidden from a creature and miss it
with a ranged weapon attack, making the attack
doesn’t reveal your position.
Dim light doesn’t impose disadvantage on your
Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.
